placebo.name: Placebo
placebo.desc:
A general, all-purpose Medicine.

The less one knows about it, the better it works.

basicbooster.name: Vitamin Chews
basicbooster.desc: Minorly reduces the chance of becoming sick.
basicbooster.recipedesc:
A supplement that minorly reduces the chance of contracting a Germ-based Disease.

Must be taken daily.

intermediatebooster.name: Immuno Booster
intermediatebooster.desc: Significantly reduces the chance of becoming sick.
intermediatebooster.recipedesc:
A supplement that significantly reduces the chance of contracting a Germ-based Disease.

Must be taken daily.

antihistamine.name: Allergy Medication
antihistamine.recipedesc: A strong antihistamine Duplicants can take to halt an allergic reaction. Allergy Medication will also prevent further reactions from occurring for a short time after ingestion.

basiccure.name: Curative Tablet
basiccure.desc: A simple, easy-to-take remedy for minor germ-based diseases.
basiccure.recipedesc:
Duplicants can take this to cure themselves of minor Germ-based Diseases.

Curative Tablets are very effective against Food Poisoning.

intermediatecure.name: Medical Pack
intermediatecure.desc: A doctor-administered cure for moderate ailments.
intermediatecure.recipedesc:
A doctor-administered cure for moderate Diseases. Medical Packs are very effective against Slimelung.

Must be administered by a Duplicant with the Bedside Manner Skill.

advancedcure.name: Serum Vial
advancedcure.desc: A doctor-administered cure for severe ailments.
advancedcure.recipedesc:
An extremely powerful medication created to treat severe Diseases. Serum Vial is very effective against Zombie Spores.

Must be administered by a Duplicant with the Advanced Medical Care Skill.

basicradpill.name: Basic Rad Pill
basicradpill.desc: Increases a Duplicant's natural radiation absorption rate.
basicradpill.recipedesc:
A supplement that speeds up the rate at which a Duplicant body absorbs radiation, allowing them to manage increased radiation exposure.

Must be taken daily.

intermediateradpill.name: Intermediate Rad Pill
intermediateradpill.desc: Increases a Duplicant's natural radiation absorption rate.
intermediateradpill.recipedesc:
A supplement that speeds up the rate at which a Duplicant body absorbs radiation, allowing them to manage increased radiation exposure.

Must be taken daily.

lubricationstick.name: Gear Balm
lubricationstick.desc:
Provides a small amount of lubricating Gear Oil.

Can be produced at the Apothecary.
lubricationstick.recipedesc: A self-administered mechanical lubricant for Duplicants with bionic parts.

tallowlubricationstick.name: Tallow Gear Balm
tallowlubricationstick.desc:
Provides a small amount of extra-silky lubricating Gear Oil.

Can be produced at the Apothecary.
tallowlubricationstick.recipedesc: An advanced self-administered mechanical lubricant for Duplicants with bionic parts.

bionic_boosters.fabrication_source: This booster can be manufactured at the {0}.

booster_dig1.name: Digging Booster
booster_dig1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the skill required to dig hard things.

booster_dig2.name: Extreme Digging Booster
booster_dig2.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the digging skill required to get through anything.

booster_construct1.name: Construction Booster
booster_construct1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the ability to build fast, and demolish buildings that others cannot.

booster_farm1.name: Crop Tending Booster
booster_farm1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant unparalleled farming and botanical analysis skills.

booster_ranch1.name: Ranching Booster
booster_ranch1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the skills required to care for Critters in every way.

booster_cook1.name: Grilling Booster
booster_cook1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant deliciously professional culinary skills.

booster_art1.name: Masterworks Art Booster
booster_art1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant flawless decorating skills.

booster_research1.name: Researching Booster
booster_research1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the expertise required to study geysers and other advanced topics.

booster_research2.name: Astronomy Booster
booster_research2.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant a keen grasp of science and usage of space-research buildings.

booster_research3.name: Applied Sciences Booster
booster_research3.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant a deeply pragmatic approach to scientific research.

booster_pilot1.name: Piloting Booster
booster_pilot1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the expertise required to explore the skies in person.

booster_pilotvanilla1.name: Rocketry Booster
booster_pilotvanilla1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the expertise required to command a rocket.

booster_suits1.name: Suit Training Booster
booster_suits1.desc: Enables a Bionic Duplicant to maximize durability of equipped Exosuits and maintain their runspeed.

booster_carry1.name: Strength Booster
booster_carry1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant increased carrying capacity and athletic prowess.

booster_op1.name: Electrical Engineering Booster
booster_op1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the skills requried to tinker and solder to their heart's content.

booster_op2.name: Mechatronics Engineering Booster
booster_op2.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant complete mastery of engineering skills.

booster_medicine1.name: Advanced Medical Booster
booster_medicine1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the ability to perform all doctoring errands.

booster_tidy1.name: Tidying Booster
booster_tidy1.desc: Grants a Bionic Duplicant the full range of tidying skills, including blasting unwanted meteors out of the sky.

foodsplat.name: Food Splatter
foodsplat.desc: Food smeared on the wall from a recent Food Fight

burger.name: Frost Burger
burger.desc:
Meat and Lettuce on a chilled Frost Bun.

It's the only burger best served cold.
burger.recipedesc: Meat and Lettuce on a chilled Frost Bun.

dehydrated.name: Dried Frost Burger
dehydrated.desc:
A dehydrated Frost Burger ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

fieldration.name: Nutrient Bar
fieldration.desc: A nourishing nutrient paste, sandwiched between thin wafer layers.

mushbar.name: Mush Bar
mushbar.desc:
An edible, putrefied mudslop.

Mush Bars are preferable to starvation, but only just barely.
mushbar.recipedesc:
An edible, putrefied mudslop.

Mush Bars are preferable to starvation, but only just barely.

mushroomwrap.name: Mushroom Wrap
mushroomwrap.desc:
Flavorful Mushrooms wrapped in Lettuce.

It has an earthy flavor punctuated by a refreshing crunch.

dehydrated.name: Dried Mushroom Wrap
dehydrated.desc:
A dehydrated Mushroom Wrap ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

microwavedlettuce.name: Microwaved Lettuce
microwavedlettuce.desc: Lettuce scrumptiously wilted in the Gamma Ray Oven.
microwavedlettuce.recipedesc: Lettuce scrumptiously wilted in the Gamma Ray Oven.

gammamush.name: Gamma Mush
gammamush.desc: A disturbingly delicious mixture of irradiated dirt and water.
gammamush.recipedesc: Mush Fry reheated in a Gamma Ray Oven.

fruitcake.name: Berry Sludge
fruitcake.desc:
A mashed up Bristle Berry sludge with an exceptionally long shelf life.

Its aggressive, overbearing sweetness can leave the tongue feeling temporarily numb.
fruitcake.recipedesc: A mashed up Bristle Berry sludge with an exceptionally long shelf life.

popcorn.name: Popcorn
popcorn.desc:
Sleet Wheat Grain popped in a Gamma Ray Oven.

Completely devoid of any fancy flavorings.

sushi.name: Sushi
sushi.desc:
Raw Pacu Fillet wrapped with fresh Lettuce.

While the salt of the lettuce may initially overpower the flavor, a keen palate can discern the subtle sweetness of the fillet beneath.
sushi.recipedesc: Raw Pacu Fillet wrapped with fresh Lettuce.

hatchegg.name: Hatch Egg
hatchegg.desc:
An egg laid by a Hatch.

If incubated, it will hatch into a Hatchling.
hatchegg.recipedesc: An egg laid by a Hatch.

dreckoegg.name: Drecko Egg
dreckoegg.desc:
An egg laid by a Drecko.

If incubated, it will hatch into a new Drecklet.
dreckoegg.recipedesc: An egg laid by a Drecko.

lightbugegg.name: Shine Bug Egg
lightbugegg.desc:
An egg laid by a Shine Bug.

If incubated, it will hatch into a Shine Nymph.
lightbugegg.recipedesc: An egg laid by a Shine Bug.

lettuce.name: Lettuce
lettuce.desc: Crunchy, slightly salty leaves from a Waterweed plant.

pasta.name: Pasta
pasta.desc: pasta made from egg and wheat
pasta.recipedesc: pasta made from egg and wheat

pancakes.name: Soufflé Pancakes
pancakes.desc:
Sweet discs made from Raw Egg and Sleet Wheat Grain.

They're so thick!
pancakes.recipedesc: Sweet discs made from Raw Egg and Sleet Wheat Grain.

oilfloateregg.name: Slickster Egg
oilfloateregg.desc:
An egg laid by a Slickster.

If incubated, it will hatch into a Slickster Larva.
oilfloateregg.recipedesc: An egg laid by a Slickster.

puftegg.name: Puft Egg
puftegg.desc:
An egg laid by a Puft.

If incubated, it will hatch into a Puftlet.
puftegg.recipedesc: An egg laid by a Puft.

prehistoricpacufillet.name: Jawbo Fillet
prehistoricpacufillet.desc: An uncooked fillet from a very dead Jawbo. It has a silky texture.

fishmeat.name: Pacu Fillet
fishmeat.desc: An uncooked fillet from a very dead Pacu. Yum!

meat.name: Meat
meat.desc: Uncooked meat from a very dead critter. Yum!

dinosaurmeat.name: Tough Meat
dinosaurmeat.desc:
Uncooked meat from a very dead critter.

It's inedible until cooked in the Smoker.

smokeddinosaurmeat.name: Tender Brisket
smokeddinosaurmeat.desc: A cooked stack of tough meat that's been marinated and slow-smoked to tender perfection.
smokeddinosaurmeat.recipedesc: A stack of tender, slow-smoked meat.

smokedfish.name: Smoked Fish
smokedfish.desc:
A buttery smoked fish fillet.

It flakes nicely when pulled apart with a fork.

smokedvegetables.name: Veggie Poppers
smokedvegetables.desc: Crisp vegetables stuffed with herbs and smoked for hours.

plantmeat.name: Plant Meat
plantmeat.desc: Planty plant meat from a plant. How nice!

shellfishmeat.name: Raw Shellfish
shellfishmeat.desc: An uncooked chunk of very dead Sanishell. Yum!

mushroom.name: Mushroom
mushroom.desc: An edible, flavorless fungus that grew in the dark.

cookedfish.name: Cooked Seafood
cookedfish.desc:
A cooked piece of freshly caught aquatic critter.

Unsurprisingly, it tastes a bit fishy.
cookedfish.recipedesc: A cooked piece of freshly caught aquatic critter.

cookedmeat.name: Barbeque
cookedmeat.desc:
The cooked meat of a defeated critter.

It has a delightful smoky aftertaste.
cookedmeat.recipedesc: The cooked meat of a defeated critter.

friescarrot.name: Squash Fries
friescarrot.recipedesc: Crunchy sticks of Plume Squash deep-fried in Tallow.

deepfriedfish.name: Fish Taco
deepfriedfish.desc: Deep-fried fish cradled in a crunchy fin.
deepfriedfish.recipedesc: Pacu Fillet lightly battered and deep-fried in Tallow.

deepfriedshellfish.name: Shellfish Tempura
deepfriedshellfish.recipedesc: A tender chunk of battered Raw Shellfish deep-fried in Tallow.

deepfriedmeat.name: Deep Fried Steak
deepfriedmeat.desc: A juicy slab of meat with a crunchy deep-fried upper layer.
deepfriedmeat.recipedesc: A juicy slab of Raw Meat deep-fried in Tallow.

deepfriednosh.name: Nosh Noms
deepfriednosh.desc: A snackable handful of crunchy beans.
deepfriednosh.recipedesc: A crunchy stack of Nosh Beans deep-fried in Tallow.

pickledmeal.name: Pickled Meal
pickledmeal.desc:
Meal Lice preserved in vinegar.

It's a rarely acquired taste.
pickledmeal.recipedesc: Meal Lice regrettably preserved in vinegar.

friedmushbar.name: Mush Fry
friedmushbar.desc:
Pan-fried, solidified mudslop.

The inside is almost completely uncooked, despite the crunch on the outside.

rawegg.name: Raw Egg
rawegg.desc:
A raw Egg that has been cracked open for use in Food preparation.

It will never hatch.
rawegg.recipedesc: A raw egg that has been cracked open for use in Food preparation.

cookedegg.name: Omelette
cookedegg.desc:
Fluffed and folded Egg innards.

It turns out you do, in fact, have to break a few eggs to make it.

friedmushroom.name: Fried Mushroom
friedmushroom.desc:
A pan-fried dish made with a fruiting Dusk Cap.

It has a thick, savory flavor with subtle earthy undertones.
friedmushroom.recipedesc: A pan-fried dish made with a fruiting Dusk Cap.

cookedpikeapple.name: Pikeapple Skewer
cookedpikeapple.desc:
Grilling a Pikeapple softens its spikes, making it slighly less awkward to eat.

It does not diminish the smell.
cookedpikeapple.recipedesc: A grilled dish made with a fruiting Pikeapple.

pricklefruit.name: Bristle Berry
pricklefruit.desc: A sweet, mostly pleasant-tasting fruit covered in prickly barbs.

grilledpricklefruit.name: Gristle Berry
grilledpricklefruit.desc:
The grilled bud of a Bristle Berry.

Heat unlocked an exquisite taste in the fruit, though the burnt spines leave something to be desired.
grilledpricklefruit.recipedesc: The grilled bud of a Bristle Berry.

swampfruit.name: Bog Jelly
swampfruit.desc: A fruit with an outer film that contains chewy gelatinous cubes.

swampdelights.name: Swampy Delights
swampdelights.desc:
Dried gelatinous cubes from a Bog Jelly.

Each cube has a wonderfully chewy texture and is lightly coated in a delicate powder.
swampdelights.recipedesc: Dried gelatinous cubes from a Bog Jelly.

wormbasicfruit.name: Spindly Grubfruit
wormbasicfruit.desc:
A Grubfruit that failed to develop properly.

It is nonetheless edible, and vaguely tasty.

wormbasicfood.name: Roast Grubfruit Nut
wormbasicfood.desc:
Slow roasted Spindly Grubfruit.

It has a smoky aroma and tastes of coziness.

wormsuperfruit.name: Grubfruit
wormsuperfruit.desc: A plump, healthy fruit with a honey-like taste.

wormsuperfood.name: Grubfruit Preserve
wormsuperfood.desc:
A long lasting Grubfruit jam preserved in Sucrose.

The thick, goopy jam retains the shape of the jar when poured out, but the sweet taste can't be matched.
wormsuperfood.recipedesc: A long lasting Grubfruit jam preserved in Sucrose.

berrypie.name: Mixed Berry Pie
berrypie.desc:
A pie made primarily of Grubfruit and Gristle Berries.

The mixture of berries creates a fragrant, colorful filling that packs a sweet punch.
berrypie.recipedesc: A pie made primarily of Grubfruit and Gristle Berries.

dehydrated.name: Dried Berry Pie
dehydrated.desc:
A dehydrated Mixed Berry Pie ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

coldwheatbread.name: Frost Bun
coldwheatbread.desc:
A simple bun baked from Sleet Wheat Grain.

Each bite leaves a mild cooling sensation in one's mouth, even when the bun itself is warm.
coldwheatbread.recipedesc: A simple bun baked from Sleet Wheat Grain.

bean.name: Nosh Bean
bean.desc:
The crisp bean of a Nosh Sprout.

Each bite tastes refreshingly natural and wholesome.

spicenut.name: Pincha Peppernut
spicenut.desc:
The flavorful nut of a Pincha Pepperplant.

The bitter outer rind hides a rich, peppery core that is useful in cooking.

vinefruit.name: Ovagro Fig
vinefruit.desc:
The fruit from an Ovagro Vine.

It's fun to squeeze as many as possible into a single mouthful.

spicebread.name: Pepper Bread
spicebread.desc:
A loaf of bread, lightly spiced with Pincha Peppernut for a mild bite.

There's a simple joy to be had in pulling it apart in one's fingers.
spicebread.recipedesc: A loaf of bread, lightly spiced with Pincha Peppernut for a mild bite.

dehydrated.name: Dried Pepper Bread
dehydrated.desc:
A dehydrated Pepper Bread ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

surfandturf.name: Surf'n'Turf
surfandturf.desc:
A bit of Meat from the land and Cooked Seafood from the sea.

It's hearty and satisfying.
surfandturf.recipedesc: A bit of Meat from the land and Cooked Seafood from the sea.

dehydrated.name: Dried Surf'n'Turf
dehydrated.desc:
A dehydrated Surf'n'Turf ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

tofu.name: Tofu
tofu.desc:
A bland curd made from Nosh Beans.

It has an unusual but pleasant consistency.
tofu.recipedesc: A bland curd made from Nosh Beans.

spicytofu.name: Spicy Tofu
spicytofu.desc:
Tofu marinated in a flavorful Pincha Peppernut sauce.

It packs a delightful punch.
spicytofu.recipedesc: Tofu marinated in a flavorful Pincha Peppernut sauce.

dehydrated.name: Dried Spicy Tofu
dehydrated.desc:
A dehydrated Spicy Tofu ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

curry.name: Curried Beans
curry.desc:
Chewy Nosh Beans simmered with chunks of Tonic Root.

It's so spicy!
curry.recipedesc: Chewy Nosh Beans simmered with chunks of Tonic Root.

dehydrated.name: Dried Curried Beans
dehydrated.desc:
A dehydrated Curried Beans ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

salsa.name: Stuffed Berry
salsa.desc: A baked Bristle Berry stuffed with delectable spices and vibrantly flavored.
salsa.recipedesc: A baked Bristle Berry stuffed with delectable spices and vibrantly flavored.

dehydrated.name: Dried Stuffed Berry
dehydrated.desc:
A dehydrated Stuffed Berry ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

hardskinberry.name: Pikeapple
hardskinberry.desc: An edible fruit encased in a thorny husk.

carrot.name: Plume Squash
carrot.desc: An edible tuber with an earthy, elegant flavor.

fernfood.name: Megafrond Grain
fernfood.desc: An ancient grain that can be processed into Food.

pemmican.name: Pemmican
pemmican.desc:
Meat and Tallow pounded into a calorie-dense brick with an exceptionally long shelf life.

Survival never tasted so good.
pemmican.recipedesc: Meat and Tallow pounded into a nutrient-dense brick with an exceptionally long shelf life.

basicplantfood.name: Meal Lice
basicplantfood.desc: A flavorless grain that almost never wiggles on its own.

basicplantbar.name: Liceloaf
basicplantbar.desc: Meal Lice compacted into a dense, immobile loaf.
basicplantbar.recipedesc: Meal Lice compacted into a dense, immobile loaf.

basicforageplant.name: Muckroot
basicforageplant.desc:
A seedless fruit with an upsettingly bland aftertaste.

It cannot be replanted.

Digging up Buried Objects may uncover a Muckroot.

forestforageplant.name: Hexalent Fruit
forestforageplant.desc:
A seedless fruit with an unusual rubbery texture.

It cannot be replanted.

Hexalent fruit is much more calorie dense than Muckroot fruit.

swampforageplant.name: Swamp Chard Heart
swampforageplant.desc:
A seedless plant with a squishy, juicy center and an awful smell.

It cannot be replanted.

icecavesforageplant.name: Sherberry
icecavesforageplant.desc:
A cold seedless fruit that triggers mild brain freeze.

It cannot be replanted.

rotpile.name: Rot Pile
rotpile.desc:
An inedible glop of former foodstuff.

Rot Piles break down into Polluted Dirt over time.

coldwheatseed.name: Sleet Wheat Grain
coldwheatseed.desc: An edible grain that leaves a cool taste on the tongue.

beanplantseed.name: Nosh Bean
beanplantseed.desc: An inedible bean that can be processed into delicious foods.

quiche.name: Mushroom Quiche
quiche.desc: Omelette, Fried Mushroom and Lettuce piled onto a yummy crust. Somehow, it's both soggy and crispy.
quiche.recipedesc: Omelette, Fried Mushroom and Lettuce piled onto a yummy crust.

dehydrated.name: Dried Mushroom Quiche
dehydrated.desc:
A dehydrated Mushroom Quiche ration. It must be rehydrated in order to be considered Food.

Dry rations have no expiry date.

gardenfoodplantfood.name: Sweatcorn
gardenfoodplantfood.desc:
The sugary vegetable produced by Sweatcorn Stalks.

It tastes a lot better deep-fried.

gardenforageplant.name: Snac Fruit
gardenforageplant.desc:
A seedless fruit that loses its flavor long before it is fully chewed.

It cannot be replanted.

Digging up Buried Objects may uncover a Snac Fruit.

butterflyplantseed.name: Mimillet
butterflyplantseed.desc:
An inedible seed from a Mimika Bud.

It can be sown to cultivate more plants, or processed into Food.

Digging up Buried Objects may uncover a Mimillet Seed.

butterflyfood.name: Toasted Mimillet
butterflyfood.desc:
A lightly toasted Mimillet.

It makes the tummy feel a bit fluttery.

swamplilyflower.name: Balm Lily Flower
swamplilyflower.desc:
A medicinal flower that soothes most minor maladies.

It is exceptionally fragrant.

ginger.name: Tonic Root
ginger.desc: A chewy, fibrous rhizome with a fiery aftertaste.

kelp.name: Seakomb Leaf
kelp.desc:
The leaf of a Seakomb.

It can be processed into Phyto Oil or used as an ingredient in Allergy Medication.

electrobank_uranium_ore.name: Uranium Ore Power Bank
electrobank_uranium_ore.desc:
A disposable Power Bank made with Uranium Ore.

It can power buildings via Large Dischargers or Compact Dischargers.

Duplicants can produce new Uranium Ore Power Banks at the Crafting Station.

Must be kept dry.

electrobank_metal_ore.name: Metal Power Bank
electrobank_metal_ore.desc:
A disposable Power Bank made with Metal Ore.

It can power buildings via Large Dischargers or Compact Dischargers.

Duplicants can produce new Metal Power Banks at the Crafting Station.

Must be kept dry.

electrobank_selfcharging.name: Atomic Power Bank
electrobank_selfcharging.desc:
A self-charging Power Bank made with Enriched Uranium.

It can power buildings via Large Dischargers or Compact Dischargers.

Its low wattage and high Radioactivity make it unsuitable for Bionic Duplicant use.

electrobank.name: Eco Power Bank
electrobank.desc:
A rechargeable Power Bank.

It can power buildings via Large Dischargers or Compact Dischargers.

Duplicants can produce new Eco Power Banks at the Soldering Station.

Must be kept dry.

electrobank_empty.name: Empty Eco Power Bank
electrobank_empty.desc:
A depleted Power Bank.

It must be recharged at a Power Bank Charger before it can be reused.

electrobank_garbage.name: Power Bank Scrap
electrobank_garbage.desc:
A Power Bank that has reached the end of its lifetime.

It can be salvaged for Abyssalite at the Rock Crusher.

fuel_brick.name: Fuel Brick
fuel_brick.desc:
A densely compressed brick of combustible material.

It can be burned to produce a one-time burst of Power.

basic_fabric.name: Reed Fiber
basic_fabric.desc: A ball of raw cellulose used in the production of Clothing and textiles.

plant_fiber.name: Plant Husk
plant_fiber.desc:
A bundle of dried plant matter.

It can be eaten by Moos, or processed into fuel or building materials.

feather_fabric.name: Feather Fiber
feather_fabric.desc: A stalk of raw keratin used in the production of Clothing and textiles.

dewdrip.name: Dewdrip
dewdrip.desc: A crystallized blob of Brackene from the Dew Dripper.

trap_parts.name: Trap Components
trap_parts.desc: These components can be assembled into a Critter Trap and used to catch Critters.

power_station_tools.name: Microchip
power_station_tools.desc:
A specialized Microchip created by a professional engineer.

Tunes up Generators to increase their Power output.

Also used in the production of Boosters for Bionic Duplicants.
power_station_tools.tinker_requirement_tooltip: Can only be used by a Duplicant with Electrical Engineering to apply a Tune Up.
power_station_tools.tinker_effect_tooltip: Can be used to Tune Up a generator, increasing its {0} by {1}.

farm_station_tools.name: Micronutrient Fertilizer
farm_station_tools.desc:
Specialized Fertilizer mixed by a Duplicant with the Crop Tending Skill.

Increases the Growth Rate of one Plant.

machine_parts.name: Custom Parts
machine_parts.desc:
Specialized Parts crafted by a professional engineer.

Jerry Rig machine buildings to increase their efficiency.
machine_parts.tinker_requirement_tooltip: Can only be used by a Duplicant with Mechatronics Engineering to apply a Jerry Rig.
machine_parts.tinker_effect_tooltip: Can be used to Jerry Rig upgrades to a machine building, increasing its {0} by {1}.

research_databank.name: Data Bank
research_databank.desc: Raw data that can be processed into Interstellar Research points.

orbital_research_databank.name: Data Bank
orbital_research_databank.desc: Raw Data that can be processed into Data Analysis Research points.
orbital_research_databank.recipe_desc:
Data Banks of raw data generated from exploring, either by exploring new areas with Duplicants, or by using an Orbital Data Collection Lab.

Used by the Virtual Planetarium to conduct research.

egg_shell.name: Egg Shell
egg_shell.desc: Can be crushed to produce Lime.

gold_belly_crown.name: Regal Bammoth Crest
gold_belly_crown.desc: Can be crushed to produce Gold Amalgam.

crab_shell.name: Pokeshell Molt
crab_shell.desc: Can be crushed to produce Lime.

variant_wood.name: Oakshell Molt
variant_wood.desc: Can be crushed to produce Wood.

baby_crab_shell.name: Small Pokeshell Molt
baby_crab_shell.desc: Can be crushed to produce Lime.

variant_wood.name: Small Oakshell Molt
variant_wood.desc: Can be crushed to produce Wood.

wood.name: Wood
wood.desc:
Natural resource harvested from certain Critters and Plants.

Used in construction or Heat production.

gene_shuffler_recharge.name: Vacillator Recharge
gene_shuffler_recharge.desc: Replenishes one charge to a depleted Neural Vacillator.

table_salt.name: Table Salt
table_salt.desc: A seasoning that Duplicants can add to their Food to boost Morale. Duplicants will automatically use Table Salt while sitting at a Mess Table during mealtime. Only the finest grains are chosen.

refined_sugar.name: Refined Sugar
refined_sugar.desc: A seasoning that Duplicants can add to their Food to boost Morale. Duplicants will automatically use Refined Sugar while sitting at a Mess Table during mealtime. Only the finest grains are chosen.

ice_belly_poop.name: Bammoth Patty
ice_belly_poop.desc:
A little treat left behind by a very large critter.

It can be crushed to extract Phosphorite and Clay.

cargo_capsule.name: Care Package
cargo_capsule.desc:
A delivery system for recently printed resources.

It will dematerialize shortly.

railgunpayload.name: Interplanetary Payload
railgunpayload.desc:
Contains resources packed for interstellar shipping.

Can be launched by a Interplanetary Launcher or unpacked with a Payload Opener.

missile_basic.name: Blastshot
missile_basic.desc:
An explosive projectile designed to defend against meteor showers.

Must be launched by a Meteor Blaster.

missile_longrange_vanilladlc4.name: Intracosmic Blastshot
missile_longrange_vanilladlc4.desc:
A long-range explosive projectile that defends against distant space objects.

Must be launched by Meteor Blaster.

missile_longrange.name: Intracosmic Blastshot
missile_longrange.desc:
A long-range explosive projectile that defends against distant space objects.

Must be launched by Meteor Blaster.

debrispayload.name: Rocket Debris
debrispayload.desc: Whatever is left over from a Rocket Self-Destruct can be recovered once it has crash-landed.

highenergyparitcle.name: Radbolts
highenergyparitcle.desc: A concentrated field of Radbolts that can be largely redirected using a Radbolt Reflector.

dreamjournal.name: Dream Journal
dreamjournal.desc:
A hand-scrawled account of Pajama-induced dreams.

Can be analyzed using a Somnium Synthesizer.

dehydratedfoodpackage.name: Dry Ration
dehydratedfoodpackage.desc:
A package of non-perishable dehydrated food.

It requires no refrigeration, but must be rehydrated before consumption.

piloting_spice.name: Rocketeer Spice
piloting_spice.desc: Provides a boost to piloting abilities.

preserving_spice.name: Freshener Spice
preserving_spice.desc: Slows the decomposition of perishable foods.

strength_spice.name: Brawny Spice
strength_spice.desc: Strengthens even the weakest of muscles.
